errors.evidence: The description states the unperturbed bar has an accuracy of around 92, but the figure shows it is approximately 90.
The description states the 1st layer bar has an accuracy of around 82, but the figure shows it is approximately 80.
The description stating green and red bars have values from 79 to 82 is incorrect; the green bars are around 80-85, and red bars are about 70-75.
The description does not include the tick intervals for the y-axis, which is important for understanding the scale.
The description omits mention of grouping, indicating that each category has two bars instead of clearly differentiating between them.
